description: Source code for the MessageControl plugin implementation, including initialization, deinitialization, and WebSocket communication handling.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Implements message control functionalities including WebSocket communication, configuration, and resource management.

classes.name: MessageControl::Config::NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents network node configuration with port and binding address.

methods.name: MessageControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message control plugin, sets up message output, and registers with message control interface.

methods.name: MessageControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, and releases references.

methods.name: MessageControl::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: MessageControl::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel for communication.

methods.name: MessageControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages either as a string or with an ID and JSON element.
